description_en: Retrieves a list of Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instances based on the specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数获取GTM 3.0实例列表
name: ListCloudGtmInstances

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh-CN：中文。

en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The page number. Starting value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The paging Settings for a paged query specify the number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance, which helps identify the business purpose of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称，方便区分实例的业务用途
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the instance
parameters.name: charge_type

ChargeType.description_en: The billing method of the instance

CommodityCode.description_en:
The commodity code. Valid values:

dns_gtm_public_cn: the commodity code for Alibaba Cloud China site

dns_gtm_public_intl: the commodity code for Alibaba Cloud International site
CommodityCode.description_zh:
商品编码：

dns_gtm_public_cn：中国站商品编码。

dns_gtm_public_intl：国际站商品编码

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 实例创建时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of when the instance was created

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ format
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例到期时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

ExpireTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of when the instance expires

MonitorTaskQuota.description_en: The quota for monitoring probe tasks

MonthlyEmailUsed.description_en: The number of emails sent in the current month

MonthlySmsQuota.description_en: The monthly SMS quota. SMS is supported only on the Alibaba Cloud China site and is not supported on the Alibaba Cloud International site
MonthlySmsQuota.description_zh: 短息配额，仅中国站支持短消息，国际站不支持短消息

MonthlySmsUsed.description_en: The number of SMS messages sent in the current month. SMS is supported only on the Alibaba Cloud China site and is not supported on the Alibaba Cloud International site
MonthlySmsUsed.description_zh: 当月短信发送量，仅中国站支持短信，国际站不支持短信

MonthlyWebhookUsed.description_en: The number of webhooks sent in the current month

ScheduleDomainName.description_en: The access domain name of the GTM instance. The format is the host record of the access domain name (the value of the ScheduleHostname parameter) plus the primary domain name or subdomain name (the value of the ScheduleZoneName parameter)
ScheduleDomainName.description_zh: GTM接入域名。格式为接入域名主机记录（ScheduleHostname参数值）+主域或子域（ScheduleZoneName参数值）

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was last updated. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 实例最后一次修改时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of when the instance was last updated
UpdateTimestamp.description_zh: 实例最后一次修改时间（时间戳）

VersionCode.description_en:
The edition of the GTM instance. Valid values:

standard: Standard Edition

ultimate: Ultimate Edition
VersionCode.description_zh:
GTM实例版本：

standard：标准版

ultimate：旗舰版

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Starting value: 1. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The paging Settings for a paged query specify the number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages returned
